## INPEX Awards McDermott-Baker Hughes Consortium Contract for Ichthys LNG Development


11/19/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 1.03 MB](https://s21.q4cdn.com/548121662/files/doc_news/INPEX-Awards-McDermott-Baker-Hughes-Consortium-Contract-for-Ichthys-LNG-Development-2026.pdf)


HOUSTON and LONDON, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Baker Hughes (NASDAQ: BKR), an energy technology company, in consortium with McDermott, has been awarded a contract by INPEX for the next phase of the Ichthys liquefied natural gas (LNG) development offshore Western Australia.


The contract was awarded under the consortium’s existing Subsea Development Framework Agreement with INPEX. It covers the engineering, procurement, construction, installation (EPCI) and commissioning of new subsea infrastructure that will tie back to the existing Ichthys offshore production system.


Baker Hughes’ scope represents a significant award for subsea trees, controls, wellheads and associated services.


“Efficient and reliable offshore natural gas production relies on advanced subsea infrastructure,” said Domenico Di Giambattista, Baker Hughes vice president of Subsea & Surface Pressure Systems. “This consortium brings Baker Hughes’ subsea technology and decades of expertise together with McDermott’s end-to-end EPCI capabilities to help INPEX safely manage the complexities of the Ichthys LNG development, maximize the value of the asset and support energy security across the Asia-Pacific region.”


“This award underscores the value of our framework agreement with INPEX, giving the customer a streamlined, low-risk path from concept to execution on a development we know well,” said Mahesh Swaminathan, McDermott’s senior vice president, Subsea and Floating Facilities. “Together with Baker Hughes, we will apply an integrated engineering, fabrication and installation model across Australia and Asia to help INPEX bring new wells online and unlock further value from the Ichthys LNG development.”


The consortium will manage the project from Perth, Australia, with engineering also performed at McDermott’s offices in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, and Chennai, India. Fabrication will take place at McDermott’s facility in Batam, Indonesia.


Ichthys LNG’s offshore production facilities are located in the Browse Basin about 220 kilometers (136 miles) off the north-west coast of Western Australia.
